incident-bot: [PAGER] HIGH: GPU pool "hotpath-prod-7" saturated in us-west-2. Queue depth rising >95%, sustained 429 spike. Autoscaler attempted scale but requests pending. Paging: @oncall_jia @sre_paul

oncall_jia: On it. Looking at logs now, will post quick snapshot.

oncall_jia: log tail from hotpath-prod-7:```
2026-03-15T14:02:10Z hotpath-prod-7 queue_depth=11230 429_5m=720
2026-03-15T14:02:20Z hotpath-prod-7 queue_depth=11890 429_5m=760
2026-03-15T14:02:30Z autoscaler requestScale(pool=hotpath-prod-7, delta=+4) status=PENDING lock=tokenbucket-controller-3
2026-03-15T14:02:35Z tokenbucket: refill_rate=50 capacity=1000 burst=2000 window_ms=1000
```

sre_paul: That tokenbucket refill looks tiny for the observed sustained QPS. Also see the autoscaler pending because of tokenbucket lock contention; controller-3 is stuck on a leader election loop in the logs. Could be locking bug in the token window code.

eng-runtime-maya: Confirming: tier policy for "hotpath" currently:```yaml
tier: hotpath
rate_policy:
  per_route_token_bucket:
    capacity: 1000
    refill_rate: 50 # tokens / sec
    burst: 2000
  fallback_pool: hotpath-warmpool
```
This was tuned for steady-state but not for multi-customer surge.

prod_support_oliver: Customers reporting errors: top affected customers: AcmeApps, FunnelFlow, ScribbleAI. AcmeApps says timeouts for inference calls ~12s -> user-facing errors. We should notify SRE + CSMs.

alice_product: +1 on notification. Which customers are on the hotpath tier? Can we quickly identify and contact the top 5?

oncall_jia: Running query to list active routes on hotpath...```sql
SELECT customer, route, qps_5m FROM route_metrics WHERE tier='hotpath' ORDER BY qps_5m DESC LIMIT 10;
-- returns AcmeApps/api/generate 310 qps, FunnelFlow/chat 280 qps, ScribbleAI/embeds 240 qps, -- etc.
```

dlc_emma: Immediate mitigation options: 1) Relax per-route token refill temporarily, 2) Trigger autoscaler override to increase pool min, 3) Reroute non-critical routes to warmpool/fallback model variant (quantized) to free hot GPUs. I can run 2) and 3) if SRE approves.

sre_paul: Agreed. Do 3) first (reroute), then 2) if queue not dropping. We should avoid permanent config changes. Prep a 30m override. Example commands:```bash
# temporarily increase pool size min/max
redwoodctl pools set-size hotpath-prod-7 --min 12 --max 48 --override --reason "incident mitigation"
# temporarily relax token refill for hotpath tier
redwoodctl ratepolicy set hotpath --token-refill 500 --burst 4000 --duration 30m --reason "mitigation"
# reroute lower-priority routes to warmpool
redwoodctl routes migrate --from-tier hotpath --to-pool hotpath-warmpool --filter "customer in ('ScribbleAI', 'FunnelFlow')" --dry-run=false
```

oncall_jia: Executing reroute for ScribbleAI and FunnelFlow now. Pushing commands.

incident-bot: Action started: routes migrate job=job-987654 status=RUNNING

oncall_jia: Reroute completed for ScribbleAI (migrated 12 routes) and FunnelFlow (8 routes). Observed temporary spike in warmpool but no OOMs.

eng-runtime-maya: Next: set override for pool size, I'll trigger tokenpolicy tweak after reroute result.

oncall_jia: Triggering pool scale override:```
> redwoodctl pools set-size hotpath-prod-7 --min 12 --max 48 --override --reason "incident mitigation"
SUCCESS: pool hotpath-prod-7 min=12 max=48 (override applied)
```

autoscaler-bot: Autoscaler received override, attempting hotpath-prod-7 scale from 6 -> 14 nodes. Provisioning requests submitted to cloud provider.

sre_paul: While we wait on clouds, relax token refill to let burst through. Applying:```
> redwoodctl ratepolicy set hotpath --token-refill 500 --burst 4000 --duration 30m --reason "incident mitigation"
APPLIED: hotpath token-refill=500 burst=4000 duration=30m
```

oncall_jia: After reroute + policy change: queue depth snapshot:```
14:06:40 queue_depth=10234 429_5m=695
14:07:10 queue_depth=7600 429_5m=480
14:08:00 queue_depth=3200 429_5m=220
14:09:25 queue_depth=890 429_5m=60
```

prod_support_oliver: AcmeApps reporting reduced errors, receiving follow-up from support. I'll escalate to CSMs for official status update.

dlc_emma: Autoscaler status: cloud provider accepted 8/8 instances; hotpath nodes reporting healthy within 90s. Fallback model variant "gpt-quant-2" handling ~18% of traffic now.

sre_paul: Root cause hypothesis: tokenbucket refill was mis-provisioned for bursty multi-tenant traffic; leader election bug in controller-3 caused temporary lock holding that prevented autoscaler reconciliation (explains PENDING scale ops). We'll capture logs and open a postmortem.

alice_product: Customer impact summary for comms: ~25mins degraded for top customers (AcmeApps: 12s to 300ms p95 after mitigation). Please ping me when postmortem draft is ready.

oncall_jia: Closing loop: current queue=120, 429_5m=5. Reverting temporary overrides in 20m unless issue recurs. Creating incident ticket INC-20260315-281 in tracker.

incident-bot: Incident INC-20260315-281 acknowledged by oncall_jia. Severity: P2 -> monitoring for 30m.

sre_paul: Action items: [ ] Run postmortem and include timeline & metrics, [ ] Add autoscaler alert when scale pending >2m, [ ] Fix tokenbucket locking bug in controller-3, [ ] Re-evaluate default hotpath token refill to be workload-aware.

prod_support_oliver: I'll send customer status and include mitigation steps.

alice_product: Thanks everyone. Please add me to postmortem review.

dlc_emma: I'll schedule a follow-up ops runbook update for tokenbucket tuning and warmpool migration steps.

oncall_jia: Leaving this thread to incident-docs. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
